messages:
Nina P: heads-up: partner demo next Fri 22:00 UTC. we need 10x L40 in us-west1 for a 2h slot. reserved preferred. can procurement confirm availability? :pray:
Omar S: reserved for demo makes sense. if vendor slow, we can do 6 L40 + 4 A100 fallback, but latency differences might show.
Ravi K: i'll draft the infra claim so procurement can see exact request. add billing tag `partner-demo-q2` please.
procurement-bot: PO check: vendor requires PO+. created draft PO #PO-9802. finance approval pending. can you attach terraform claim to move faster?
infra-bot: quota: L40 us-west1 = 8 used / 12 soft quota. requesting +10 will exceed soft quota by 6. project carve or quota bump needed.
oncall-mira: suggest carve from demo-project if finance approves. also add `accept_fallback=true` flag so procurement can auto-approve mixed allocation if vendor cancels within T-24h.
Ravi K: draft PR created (WIP): https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3411. terraform snippet below:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "partner_l40" {
  region = "us-west1"
  model  = "l40"
  count  = 10
  duration_hours = 2
  tags = ["partner-demo-q2"]
  metadata = { billing_entity = "rw-partner" }
}
```
Ravi K: added `accept_fallback = true` in PR description and a small prewarm script for KV cache: `scripts/prewarm_kv.sh --regions us-west1 --parallel 8`
Omar S: question: vendor asked for earliest pickup time. can procurement ask if they can hold resources T-48h without payment? we can finalize PO closer to the run.
procurement-bot: vendor response: can hold 48h on provisional terms if PO submitted with billing_entity. awaiting finance sign-off to convert to confirmed hold.
Nina P: ok please push billing_entity = rw-partner to PO. finance, if you see this, expedited approval would help demo. :sweat_smile:
procurement-bot: finance update: flagged PO-9802 for expedited review; estimated approval window 6-8 hours. will update here.
oncall-mira: infra action: if quota bump not possible, we'll do project carve and tag resources to the demo-project. Ravi, please include `project = "demo-project"` in the PR metadata.
Ravi K: done. updated PR w/ project tag and cost estimate in comments (~$1.6k for reserved L40s for 2h). fallback (6 L40 + 4 A100) est ~$1.3k but higher perf variance.
procurement-bot: finance approved PO-9802 at 2024-05-15T09:34Z. vendor notified and holding resources as requested.
Nina P: awesome, thanks all. i'll add the reservation link to the runbook and coordinate partner access. :sparkles:
